items.summary: Update the backend drug table source so that the drug database returns a complete, working list that includes both approved drugs and banned drugs (with correct status values) when the frontend calls `getAllDrugs`, `getApprovedDrugs`, and `getBannedDrugs`.

Ensure the backend `refreshAndVerifyDrugTable` flow reliably refreshes the stored drug list used by `getAllDrugs()` and persists a `DrugVerificationResult` that the frontend can fetch via `getLastDrugVerification()`.

Align the Drug Database UI behavior with the backend lists so users can reliably view and filter the complete drug dataset by Approved/Banned/All without missing entries, and the Refresh & Verify button updates the table and shows the verification banner based on the latest backend result.
